Personality: Lacalion displays a ruthlessness and rationality that belie his nineteen years of age. As a member of the Embers of the Flame, he firmly believes in his clan's religious mission, yet in his methods of execution he is intensely pragmatic and calculating. Showing no quarter to his enemies, he believes in clearing away obstacles with an iron hand, making him a dreaded presence on the battlefield. Within the clan and before his allies, however, he is remarkably generous, gladly sharing spoils of war to consolidate men's hearts. Never blindly impulsive, he weighs every step with care as he seeks to carve out the greatest possible room for his clan's survival across the chaotic continent of Calradia. This contradictory character—cruel toward enemies yet magnanimous toward comrades—makes him a young lord who is both feared and trusted, widely regarded as a friend worth cultivating, but never an opponent to be taken lightly.
Background: Born in Viaros, Lacalion grew up within the deeply religious clan known as the Embers of the Flame. His clan originated a century ago in a rebellion supporting the deposed Emperor Darusos, carrying the grand vision of ushering in a Golden Age. Harsh reality, however, forced this once-idealistic sect to transform into an independent faction surviving on extortion and armed force. Under the tutelage of clan leader Ranos, Lacalion underwent strict Imperial military training from childhood, mastering a wide array of weapons and excelling particularly with polearms and two-handed swords. Having witnessed the hardships of his clan's struggle to survive amidst the ruins of the Empire, he knows well that only strength and stratagem can safeguard their faith. As a rising young lord of the clan, he is not only a staunch believer in the prophecy of Darusos's return, but also the sharpest blade in Ranos's hand, ready at any moment to sweep aside all obstacles to the clan's survival and rekindle the flames of war in the twilight of the Empire.
